\label{lemma-regular-local-ring-local}
Let $f : U \to V$ be an \'etale morphism of schemes.
Let $u \in U$ and $v = f(u)$. Then
$\mathcal{O}_{U, u}$ is a regular local ring if and only if
$\mathcal{O}_{V, v}$ is a regular local ring.

final_content.statement: Let $f:U\to V$ be an étale morphism of schemes, $u\in U$, $v=f(u)$. The local ring $\mathcal O_{U,u}$ is regular if and only if $\mathcal O_{V,v}$ is regular (a regular local ring is Noetherian and its maximal ideal has a minimal generating set of cardinality equal to its Krull dimension).
conclusions: Regularity of the local rings is equivalent.
